blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Langley

items.t: Under the Township of Langley's zoning bylaw, a coach house is a home on the second storey of a detached garage only.

In the Township, the zoning bylaw caps a secondary suite at 120 m², with no percentage limit. On suites in townhouses, the Township's January 2025 suites guide says they aren't allowed, while the bylaw as amended in July 2025 says they are, so check with the Township if it matters to you.

Zoning Amendment Bylaw No. 6020 (SSMUH), adopted November 18, 2024 — eligible lots (Urban Containment Boundary, municipal water and sewer, not heritage-designated, not in a Transit-Oriented Area) may have 3 units at ≤280 m² or 4 units at 280–4,050 m²; lots over 4,050 m² are ineligible and the Township has no six-unit tier. Properties that do not qualify are instead eligible for one unit plus one secondary suite or accessory dwelling unit, depending on zoning.

Carriage houses on ALR land: for an additional home on ALR land, the garage below doesn't count toward its floor area if the home is on the second storey above a one-storey garage, the garage is for the main house's vehicles and is no bigger than the additional home's limit (90 m² or 186 m²), there's no door between them, and it's close to the main house. Otherwise, the ALR rules allow one main house of 500 m² or less, a suite only inside it, and one additional home of 90 m² (40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha).
Township taxes: Township of Langley property taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026; a 5% penalty applies at midnight July 2, 2026, and a further 5% at midnight September 3, 2026.

items.t: The Township's own documents conflict on townhouse suites: the January 2025 secondary suites guide says suites aren't allowed in townhouses or rowhouses, and the bylaw as amended in July 2025 says a suite can be in a townhouse or rowhouse.

The ALR garage exception has four conditions, not one. Second-storey placement alone does not earn the floor-area exclusion: the garage must be one storey, for the principal residence's vehicles, no larger than the additional residence's own maximum, with no internal connection, and the residence must be clustered close to the principal residence.

items.t: In the Township's zoning bylaw, a coach house is a home on the second storey of a detached garage only.
On suites in townhouses, the Township's January 2025 suites guide says they aren't allowed, while the zoning bylaw as amended in July 2025 says they are. Check with the Township.
R-CL: s.403 = 220 m² min / 464.5 m² max.

Willoughby Community Plan: Bylaw 1836 (1979), now Schedule 6 of Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025). The update bylaws (6201, 6202 and 6203) had first and second reading on May 25, 2026, with a public hearing set for June 15, 2026; I don't know of any later step.
Langley CITY is a different municipality: Zoning 2025 No. 3300 uses "carriage home"; suite = lesser of 100 m² and 40%.

ALR carriage-house exception: for an ALR additional residence, an attached garage is excluded from floor area if the residence sits on the second storey above a one-storey garage for the principal residence's vehicles, the garage does not exceed the additional residence's maximum (90 m² / 186 m²), there is no internal connection, and the residence is clustered close to the principal residence.

Strata rules: the Form B costs at most $35 plus 25¢ a page; since July 1, 2024, stratas with 5 or more lots need a depreciation report every 5 years; since November 1, 2023, at least 10% of the budget must go into the contingency reserve; rental restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022; and the only valid age bylaw is 55 and older (with exemptions from May 1, 2023).
HBP $60,000; FHSA $40,000 / $8,000; CMHC premiums 0.6%–4.5%: Vancouver EHT 3% is Vancouver only.

items.t: Coach house ownership in the Township: a coach house is a second home on a detached lot's fee-simple title, never strata. It can't be sold separately from the property, and there's no Form B for it.

Suites in the Township: the zoning bylaw caps a secondary suite at 120 m², with no percentage limit. On suites in townhouses, the Township's January 2025 guide says they aren't allowed, while the bylaw as amended in July 2025 says they are, so check with the Township if it matters to you.

Strata rules (a coach-house lot is fee simple, so these don't apply to it, but they do apply to any bare-land strata lot): the Form B must be provided within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page; since July 1, 2024, stratas with 5 or more lots need a depreciation report every 5 years; since November 1, 2023, at least 10% of the budget must go into the contingency reserve; rental restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022; and the only valid age bylaw is 55 and older, so a "45+" listing line isn't enforceable.
Property taxes — Township: Township of Langley property taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026; a 5% penalty applies at midnight July 2, 2026, and a further 5% at midnight September 3, 2026.
